def mvcc.revisionsInv (revs_ptr totalCount_ptr : Loc) (vis : List mvcc.IdxEntry) (atRev limit : w64)
    (withTotal : Bool) (i : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ rs total,
      typedPointsto revs_ptr rs (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        typedPointsto totalCount_ptr total (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          ownSlice rs
              (List.map (fun x => mvcc.revVal x.snd.fst)
                (mvcc.takeLimit (mvcc.limitOf limit) (mvcc.entryAnswers (List.take i vis) atRev)))
              (DFrac.own 1) ∗
            ownSliceCap go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.Revision rs (DFrac.own 1) ∗
              ⌜total =
                  W64 ↑(mvcc.totalOf (mvcc.limitOf limit) withTotal (mvcc.entryAnswers (List.take i vis) atRev).length)⌝)
